name: The Morning Rush
description: Regulars at the corner café each ordered a different drink and a different pastry one busy morning. Work out who had what.
clues: Between Dane and Hugo, one goes with Croissant and the other with Scone.
Dane, Felix, and Hugo go with Scone, Cinnamon, and Maple, in some order.
Either Caramel goes with Croissant or Croissant goes with Cinnamon.
Bagel goes with either Cinnamon or Maple.
If Hugo does not go with Caramel, then Hugo goes with Bagel.

hints.text: Suppose Dane went with Bagel — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Dane goes with Bagel.
Dane goes with Bagel, so it can't also go with Croissant.
Dane goes with Bagel, so it can't also go with Scone.
…but now the clue “Between Dane and Hugo, one goes with Croissant and the other with Scone” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Dane does not go with Bagel.
